verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no documented maximum concurrent requests or connections and no stated throughput-degradation threshold for the vLLM server. A developer can only work it out themselves using the built-in online-serving throughput benchmark (vllm-docs-29) and the per-response TTFT/throughput statistics (vllm-docs-28). Continuous batching (vllm-docs-3, vllm-docs-16) explains how concurrent requests are handled but gives no capacity figures. Missing for 10: a documented max-concurrency or connection limit, published guidance on when throughput degrades, settings that control concurrency (e.g., max sequences per batch), and independent load-test corroboration.
